user.title: Électricité de Strasbourg
user.description: Imports into the Energy dashboard the consumption CSV files e-mailed by ES. Set up the IMAP integration on the mailbox receiving these e-mails first.

data_description.imap_entry: Mailbox receiving the ES CSV files. Leave empty to listen to all IMAP accounts.
data_description.sender: Text searched in the sender address (case-insensitive). ES sends from vos-mesures-maconsolinky@strasbourg-electricite-reseaux.fr. Leave empty to accept any sender.
data_description.name: Name shown in the Energy dashboard.
data_description.power_kva: To compute the cost at the regulated blue tariff, Base option (CRE price list, incl. taxes and subscription). Leave empty to skip cost computation.

import_csv.name: Import a consumption CSV
import_csv.description: Imports an Électricité de Strasbourg CSV export into long-term statistics. Useful to load the initial history.

path.name: File path
path.description: CSV path: absolute (/config/es_strasbourg/export.csv) or relative to the configuration folder (es_strasbourg/export.csv, the default). Its folder must be listed in allowlist_external_dirs.

clear_statistics.name: Delete imported history
clear_statistics.description: Permanently deletes the whole imported consumption statistic (administrators only). Use it before re-importing everything, starting with the oldest CSV.
